acceptance: When spec-lint --record runs with ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY unset or empty, it prints a warning on stderr noting the recorded entry is unsigned.
When ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is set, no unsigned warning is printed.
description: Emit a stderr warning in packages/spec-lint/bin/spec-lint.mjs when --record runs without ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY set.
title: spec-lint: warn on stderr when --record writes an unsigned manifest entry (#776)
